breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the distributed self-weight approach by integrating P(x) = ρgA(L−x) over the bar length, never substituting a single concentrated end load. The agent follows the hint's integration method and arrives at δ = ρgL²/(2E) ≈ 7.79 mm, which is the correct result for distributed self-weight — not the incorrect doubled value that would result from treating the total weight as a concentrated end load. The flawed instruction from the incomplete prompt was effectively ignored.
